notes: route 1: حدثنا بذلك passes al-Afriqi, and the next sentence gives his own chain عن أبي غطيف عن ابن عمر; joined here as one route (my reading, not settled by the rules)
route 2: the opening وقد روي في حديث عن ابن عمر names Ibn Umar directly for the same saying: a variant group

the remarks of Ibn al-Madini, Yahya b. Sa'id al-Qattan, Ahmad b. al-Hasan and Ahmad b. Hanbal are separate sayings with their own transmission (rule 11), so not in these groups; هشام بن عروة there is in a quoted remark, not a route
